title: Pad Thai
description: Pad Thai is Thailand’s iconic stir-fried noodle dish, known for its perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty, and savory flavors. Made with chewy rice noodles, tamarind-based sauce, shrimp, tofu, eggs, fresh vegetables, and crushed peanuts, this classic street-food favorite delivers the signature flavors of Thai cuisine in every bite.

ingredients.title: For the Pad Thai Sauce
items: Palm sugar or brown sugar – 2 tbsp
Soy sauce – 1 tsp (optional, for extra color and umami)

ingredients.title: For the Pad Thai
items: Rice noodles – 200 g (7 oz), medium-width flat noodles
Vegetable oil – 2 tbsp (peanut or canola oil preferred)
Shrimp – 150 g (5 oz), peeled and deveined (or chicken/tofu)
Firm tofu – 100 g (3.5 oz), cut into small cubes

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Rice Noodles
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water for about 30 minutes until flexible but still slightly firm.
Drain well and set aside before stir-frying.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Making the Pad Thai Sauce
steps: Combine tamarind paste, fish sauce, palm sugar, lime juice, and soy sauce in a bowl.
Stir until the sugar dissolves completely.
Taste and adjust to achieve a balanced sweet, sour, and salty flavor.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking the Protein
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and shrimp, then stir-fry until cooked through.
Remove from the wok and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Sautéing Aromatics
steps: Add the remaining oil to the wok.
Add garlic and shallots, then stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Cooking the Eggs
steps: Push the aromatics to one side of the wok.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble gently until just set.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Adding Noodles & Sauce
steps: Add drained rice noodles to the wok.
Pour the prepared sauce over the noodles.
Toss quickly until the noodles are evenly coated and absorb the sauce.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Combining the Dish
steps: Return shrimp and tofu to the wok.
Add bean sprouts and spring onions.
Stir-fry everything together for 1–2 minutes until heated through while keeping the vegetables fresh.

instruction.title: Step 8 – Serving
steps: Transfer Pad Thai to serving plates.
Top with crushed peanuts, cilantro, and chili flakes.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with extra crushed peanuts and lime wedges for a traditional Thai presentation.
Add chili flakes or fresh chili for guests who prefer extra heat.
Pair with Thai iced tea or a refreshing cucumber salad for a complete meal.

chefTips: Use good-quality tamarind paste for authentic Pad Thai flavor and natural acidity.
Balance the sauce carefully — sweetness from palm sugar, sourness from tamarind and lime, and saltiness from fish sauce should work together.
Avoid over-soaking noodles; slightly firm noodles absorb sauce better and maintain the ideal chewy texture.
Cook quickly over high heat to create authentic wok hei and prevent soggy noodles.
Prepare all ingredients before cooking because Pad Thai comes together very quickly in the wok.
